_comment: Intervals, decompositions and stability checks the C0 and C1 runs reported as bare point estimates. Nothing here re-measures or re-trains.

distinct_asked_history_states.note: a state is (asked prefix, answer prefix), read from the banked rollout. C0's distributions are over the 160,000 USER-ROWS; this is how many distinct states those rows cover.

registered_reading_rule_on_the_random_fl._comment: DS_C0_GEOMETRY.md registered a cell assignment, applied it to the emission and never applied it to its own scale control. This is that rule, unchanged, run on the norm-matched random direction C0 already banked.

mean_removed_emission_cos1._comment: cos(z_hat - mu, e_snap - mu), mu = the bank mean. C0 reported the RAW cosine (-0.182) and, separately, that the bank is dominated by one shared direction; it never reported the cosine with that direction removed from both sides. The random row uses a norm-matched Gaussian emission scored against the SAME snapped bank entry, so it is a floor for this statistic and not a different comparison.

summary._comment: The 35 deep-sweep states of the registered 42. The 7 single-pick heap states have no per-user sidecar and are excluded, not imputed.
